# UI layer: page objects, components, locator files
- A page = `<name>.page.ts` + `<name>.locators.ts` in `src/ui/pages/<app>/`. A widget = `<widget>.component.ts` + `<widget>.locators.ts` in `src/ui/components/<widget>/`.
- Locator files are pure data: `export const XLocators = { key: { by, …, description, fallbacks? } } as const satisfies LocatorMap;` with `import type` only. Parameterised locators are arrow factories returning a LocatorDef.
- Strategy order: role → label → placeholder → text/title → testId → css. No XPath, no `:nth-child`, no generated ids.
- Primary = what users perceive; fallbacks = stable technical hooks (testId, id). Every def has a human `description`.
- In classes: `this.el = bindLocators(pageOrRoot, XLocators)`. Never call `getBy*()` or `locator('…')` in page/component files.
- Components receive their root `Locator` from the page: `new DataTable(this.el.table.locator)`.
- Expose business actions (`createAppointment`) and assertions (`expectLoaded`), not raw clicks. Register new pages in `src/fixtures/ui.fixture.ts`.
- Verify: `npm run lint:locators && npm run typecheck`. Reference implementation: `src/ui/pages/demo/login.*`.
